title: 3dZipperZapper
description: A basic program to highlight problematic volumes in data sets, especially EPI/DWI data sets with interleaved acquisition.

input_file.description: Input 3D+time file of DWIs or EPIs.
input_file.title: Input file

mask_file.description: Optional input of a single volume mask file, which gets applied to each volume in the input file.
mask_file.title: Mask file

min_slice_nvox.description: Set the minimum number of voxels to be in the mask for a given slice to be included in the calculations.
min_slice_nvox.title: Minimum slice voxels

min_streak_len.description: Minimum number of slices in a row to look for fluctuations within.
min_streak_len.title: Minimum streak length

do_out_slice_param.description: Output the map of slice parameters.
do_out_slice_param.title: Output slice parameters flag

no_out_bad_mask.description: Do not output the mask of 'bad' slices.
no_out_bad_mask.title: No output bad mask flag

no_out_text_vals.description: Do not output the 1D files of the slice parameter values.
no_out_text_vals.title: No output text values flag

dont_use_streak.description: Turn off the 'streak' criterion for identifying bad slices.
dont_use_streak.title: Don't use streak flag

dont_use_drop.description: Turn off the 'drop' criterion for identifying bad slices.
dont_use_drop.title: Don't use drop flag

dont_use_corr.description: Turn off the 'corr' criterion for identifying bad slices.
dont_use_corr.title: Don't use correlation flag

min_streak_val.description: Minimum magnitude of voxelwise relative differences to perhaps be problematic.
min_streak_val.title: Minimum streak value

min_drop_frac.description: Minimum fraction for judging if the change in 'slice parameter' differences between neighboring slices might be a sign of badness.
min_drop_frac.title: Minimum drop fraction

min_drop_diff.description: Minimum 'slice parameter' value within a single slice that might be considered a bad sign.
min_drop_diff.title: Minimum drop difference

min_corr_len.description: Minimum number of slices in a row to look for consecutive anticorrelations in brightness differences.
min_corr_len.title: Minimum correlation length

min_corr_corr.description: Threshold for the magnitude of anticorrelations to be considered potentially bad.
min_corr_corr.title: Minimum correlation value
